title: Godot 4.8-dev5 crashes on project startup in MetalHeapAllocator on macOS 27 / Apple Silicon
body:
### Tested versions

### Tested versions

- Reproducible: Godot 4.8-dev5
- Not reproducible: Godot 4.8-dev4

### System information

- macOS 27.0 (26A428)
- Apple Silicon, ARM64
- Godot Forward+
- Metal rendering backend
- Godot 4.8-dev5 official macOS build

### Issue description

Godot immediately crashes when opening my existing project in 4.8-dev5.

The same project opens correctly in 4.8-dev4. The crash occurs while the editor is starting, before the main scene is run.

The crashing stack includes:

MetalHeapAllocator::_free_allocation()
RenderingDeviceDriverMetal::texture_free()
RenderingDevice::_free_pending_resources()
RenderingDevice::texture_get_data()
RendererRD::TextureStorage::texture_2d_get()
EditorNode::_update_theme()

The project uses Terrain3D 1.0.2. Its GDExtension library is loaded when the crash occurs, but the crash stack itself contains no Terrain3D calls.

This may be related to Metal texture lifetime issue #121229, although this crash occurs during EditorNode::_update_theme() on editor startup.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the project successfully using Godot 4.8-dev4.
2. Close Godot.
3. Open the same project using the official Godot 4.8-dev5 macOS build.
4. Godot crashes immediately while starting the editor.

### Expected behaviour

The project should open as it does in 4.8-dev4.

### Actual behaviour

Godot terminates with EXC_BAD_ACCESS inside MetalHeapAllocator::_free_allocation().

### System information

MacOS 27 (Silicon) - Godot 4.8 Dev 5
